stories.title: Scholier (15) raakt hand kwijt na oprapen flitsgranaat bij protesten Frankrijk

en.title: 15-year-old student loses hand after picking up flash grenade at France protests
en.summary: A 15-year-old student was severely injured during school protests in the French city of Lens when a flash grenade he picked up exploded in his hand. The student is hospitalized but not in life-threatening condition.

stories.title: Veertien maanden voor man die ex stalkte en publiekelijk zwartmaakte

en.title: Fourteen months prison for man who stalked and publicly defamed ex-partner
en.summary: A Rotterdam court sentenced a 42-year-old man to 14 months in prison for years of stalking and harassment of his ex-partner, including unwanted contact and public defamation on social media and television.

stories.title: Vijftienjarige jongen verliest hand door granaat bij Franse onderwijsprotesten

en.title: Fifteen-year-old boy loses hand from grenade at French education protests
en.summary: A 15-year-old student lost his hand when struck by a grenade during school protests in the French city of Lens on Monday. Hundreds of schools remained closed due to safety concerns stemming from the ongoing demonstrations.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor geneeskunde naar optogenetica: een lichtknopje in de hersenen

en.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine awarded for optogenetics: a light switch in the brain
en.summary: The Nobel Prize in Medicine was awarded for optogenetics, a technique that uses light-responsive molecules discovered in algae to control brain functions. The technology allows researchers to activate brain cells using light signals.

stories.title: Vijftienjarige jongen verliest hand bij aanhoudende protesten in Frankrijk

en.title: Fifteen-year-old boy loses hand during ongoing protests in France
en.summary: A teenage student lost his hand after picking up a tear gas canister during protests in France. Schools across the country have closed for a second consecutive week due to safety concerns.

stories.title: Deens bevolkingsregister gehackt: gegevens van 8,8 miljoen mensen ingezien

en.title: Danish population register hacked: data of 8.8 million people accessed
en.summary: Denmark's population register was breached, exposing personal data of 8.8 million people.

stories.title: De Librije in Zwolle blijft het enige driesterrenrestaurant van Nederland

en.title: De Librije in Zwolle remains Netherlands' only three-star Michelin restaurant
en.summary: De Librije in Zwolle received three Michelin stars for the twenty-third time. The Netherlands gained two additional two-star restaurants: Azurite in Delft and Suis in Schin op Geul.

stories.title: De Librije blijft enige restaurant in Nederland met drie Michelinsterren

en.title: De Librije remains only restaurant in Netherlands with three Michelin stars
en.summary: Restaurant De Librije in Zwolle retained its three Michelin stars this year, maintaining its status as the Netherlands' sole three-star establishment. The restaurant has held three stars since 2004.

stories.title: Negen nieuwe sterrenrestaurants in Nederland, De Librije blijft enige met drie sterren

en.title: Nine new Michelin-starred restaurants in the Netherlands, De Librije remains the only one with three stars
en.summary: The Netherlands gained nine new Michelin-starred restaurants in a recent evaluation. De Librije retained its position as the country's sole three-star establishment.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor de Geneeskunde voor ‘optogenetica’, futuristische manier om hersencellen van buitenaf te besturen

en.title: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine awarded for 'optogenetics', futuristic method to control brain cells from outside
en.summary: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for research in optogenetics, a technique that enables external control of brain cells.

stories.title: Deens bevolkingsregister gehackt. Namen, adressen en BSN’s van bijna alle Denen buitgemaakt

en.title: Danish population register hacked. Names, addresses and ID numbers of nearly all Danes stolen
en.summary: Hackers exploited legitimate access to a Danish company's database to steal personal data including names, addresses, and ID numbers of nearly all Danish citizens. The breach was discovered in late September.

stories.title: Gegevens van bijna negen miljoen Denen buitgemaakt bij hack bevolkingsregister

en.title: Data of nearly nine million Danes stolen in population register hack
en.summary: Hackers accessed personal data of approximately 8.8 million people in Denmark's population register, including names, addresses, and ID numbers. The breach affects a significant portion of the register's approximately eleven million total entries.
